compute_bleu_score: compute the BLEU score of translated segments against one or more reference corpora
compute_bleu_with_smoothing: compute the BLEU score with Lin et al 2004 smoothing applied to n-gram precisions
extract_ngrams: extract all n-grams up to a given maximum order from an input text segment
calculate_bleu_from_files: calculate the BLEU score from a reference file and a translation file on disk
review_bleu_implementation: review the Python implementation of BLEU and smooth-BLEU for machine translation evaluation
